title: Other remedies not affected.
bodyText: The remedy provided by this chapter shall be in addition to, and shall not be deemed to affect, any other remedy.
bodyHtml: [§654-9]  Other remedies not affected.  The remedy provided by this chapter shall be in addition to, and shall not be deemed to affect, any other remedy. [L Sp 1949, c 7, pt of §1; RL 1955, §244-29; HRS §654-30; am L 1972, c 90, §1(g); ren HRS §654-9]
